record.name: Force Omnipotence
record.narrative: You impose omnipotent upon your target, forcing them to suffer experience omnipotent.
record.flavor_text: 'The Force flows through me like a river.' - Legendary Jedi

manifestation.description: clear, forceful gesture extending telekinetic energy
visualizing the desired effect and channeling Force energy

base_effect.description: You achieve unlimited power over reality itself, capable of altering the fundamental laws of the universe.

mechanics.notes: Can alter any aspect of reality at will
Unlimited power slots, no casting time, no range limitations
Can rewrite the laws of physics, create or destroy universes

class_synergies.narrative: Guardian approaches Force Omnipotence through the lens of protection, finding unexpected harmony in the manipulating the Force to achieve the impossible. Their defensive combat and protection of others guides them to vibrating air with a focused resolve that reflects their unique perspective.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +4 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to quickly master new powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Jedi Order teaches the proper use of Force powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.

llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Force Omnipotence is excellent for applying omnipotent effects to control groups of enemies. Use it at 0 unlimited range. The effects last 1 round.
